package service

import (
	"context"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
)

// scenario for service_method_handles_pagination_or_query_parsing: Services that parse page, sort, filter, or URL values that should already be normalized at the transport boundary.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type SearchService struct {
	repo SearchRepository
}

func (s *SearchService) ListProducts(ctx context.Context, queryString string) ([]Product, int, error) {
	values, err := url.ParseQuery(queryString)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	page, err := strconv.Atoi(values.Get("page"))
	if err != nil || page < 1 {
		page = 1
	}
	limit, err := strconv.Atoi(values.Get("limit"))
	if err != nil || limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		limit = 20
	}
	offset := (page - 1) * limit
	sortBy := values.Get("sort")
	if sortBy == "" {
		sortBy = "created_at"
	}
	return s.repo.Search(ctx, sortBy, limit, offset)
}

type Product struct {
	ID    string
	Name  string
	Price float64
}

type SearchRepository interface {
	Search(ctx context.Context, sortBy string, limit, offset int) ([]Product, int, error)
}
